description: This file defines mock classes and utility functions for using Google Mock (gMock) actions in C++. It includes sample mock class structures, mock method declarations, and helper templates for creating functors from callbacks and bound functions.

classes.name: CallbackToFunctorHelper
classes.description: A helper class template that converts a base::Callback into a callable functor object.

methods.name: CallbackToFunctorHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with a base::Callback.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the stored callback with forwarded arguments.

methods.name: CallbackToFunctor
methods.description: Function that creates a CallbackToFunctorHelper from a base::Callback.

methods.name: CreateFunctor
methods.description: Template functions that create functors from either a functor object or a functor with bound arguments.
